---
title: "simstim pull"
---

<!-- Generated by `just docs` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Bring a session's branch into the git repository you are in.

```text
simstim pull <host>/<session> [flags]
```

Fetches the branch that the session's folder has checked out, over your SSH connection, into a branch of the repository in the current folder: the same name, or `--into`. It changes neither working tree.

## Examples

```sh
simstim pull my-vps/auth-fix
simstim pull my-vps/auth-fix --into review/auth-fix
```

## Flags

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--force` | move the local branch even when the fetch is not a fast-forward |
| `--into <string>` | the local branch to fetch into (default: the session's branch name) |

## Flags from the parent command

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--debug[=<categories>]` | turn on the debug mode, with every category, or with the categories listed: attach, net, memory, launcher, runtime. A list binds only in the = form, such as `--debug=net` |
| `--debug-file <file>` | write the client's debug records to this file. On its own, it turns on every category (SIMSTIM_DEBUG_FILE does the same) |
